userflairs-summary: Introductory text shown at the top of Special:UserFlairs.
userflairs-intro: Help text on a group subpage. $1 is a link to Special:Upload.
userflairs-upload-link: Link text for the upload page on the group form.
userflairs-no-assigned: Shown when no groups have a flair yet.
userflairs-assigned: Heading for groups that already have a flair.
userflairs-unassigned: Heading for groups that do not have a flair yet.
userflairs-unsaved: Inline notice next to Save after the order is changed but not saved.
userflairs-drag-handle: Tooltip and accessible name for the drag handle.
userflairs-position: Accessible position of a flair in the list. $1 is the 1-based index, $2 is the total.
userflairs-moved: Screen-reader announcement after a flair is reordered. $1 is the group label, $2 is the new 1-based position.
userflairs-back: Link back to Special:UserFlairs from a group subpage.
userflairs-group-title: Title of Special:UserFlairs/group (groups subpage). $1 is the localized group name.
userflairs-file: Label for the wiki file name field.
userflairs-remove: Destructive button to delete a group's flair.
userflairs-removed: Success message after removing a flair.
userflairs-invalid-file: Error when the given file is missing or not a renderable image. $1 is the submitted file name.
userflairs-unknown-group: Error when the special-page subpage is not a known group.
